title.narrative: Contribution toward achieving the targets of National Strategic Plan for Tuberculosis prevention, care and control in Pakistan - Pakistan (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Pakistan, Tuberculosis, Mercy Corps (MC)This program has the following goals: To reduce TB mortality rate by 35% in 2026 compared to 2015.. The objectives of this program are: To increase the number of notified new TB episodes to at least 486,160 by 2026 and to maintain TB treatment success rate at more than 90% from 2024 onwards.. To increase the number of detected and treated of MDR/RR-TB cases from 3,373 in 2021 to at least 7,700 by 2026 and their treatment success rate to at least 80% from 2024 onwards.. To increase the proportion of notified TB cases with known HIV status from 52% in 2021 to 100 % by 2026 and to treat 100% of identified TB/HIV with ART every year.. To improve and enhance TB prevention through i) tuberculosis preventive therapy of, at least, 80% of household contacts and PLHIV with no active TB in 2024 to 2026 and ii) strengthening infection control.
